scope: Basic on page and API, noindex and real API health before mutations
Two synthetic .invalid accounts; owner login and independent personal method
Real method persistence and exact If-Match conflict 412
Fresh browser session, deep FR/EN reload and original personal text
limits: No remote execution or rendering observed. Four guard tests do not validate deployment.
Deployment identity is the root-supplied private proof; no version endpoint was invented.
CMS/projects, pedagogical READY access, SMTP delivery, S3 and Stripe are not configured by this harness.
Screenshots are private viewport captures, not an automatic visual review.
Synthetic records and private journal are retained; only owned contexts close.
Unexpected denials and ambiguous mutation outcomes require review, without automatic retry.
POSIX modes enforced where meaningful; private Windows inherited ACL remains an operator prerequisite.
